content.title: THE MINERAL YOUR THYROID CAN'T FUNCTION WITHOUT (AND MOST PEOPLE ARE LOW ON {{IODINE}})
facts: **Iodine** (Thyroid Fuel) — Seaweed | Cod | Shrimp | Dairy Milk
**Copper** (Energy Spark) — Oysters | Sesame Seeds | Lentils | Shiitake Mushrooms
**Manganese** (Bone Builder) — Pineapple | Brown Rice | Mussels | Cloves
**Selenium** (Cell Shield) — Brazil Nuts | Tuna | Eggs | Turkey
**Potassium** (Pressure Regulator) — Sweet Potatoes | Coconut Water | White Beans | Swiss Chard
**Zinc** (Immune Gatekeeper) — Pumpkin Seeds | Crab | Chickpeas | Lamb
**Calcium** (Signal Sender) — Sardines with Bones | Tahini | Collard Greens | Yogurt
**Follow along** – for more daily health tips like this.
content.caption:
A few of these minerals do more than people realize. Iodine gets pulled straight into your thyroid to make the hormones that set your metabolism speed — too little and your body quite literally slows itself down. Copper works quietly alongside iron, helping your cells actually use the iron you eat instead of letting it sit unused in your blood. And selenium acts like a shield inside your cells, helping neutralize damage before it builds up over time — just one or two Brazil nuts a day covers most people's needs. Everyone's body is different, so pay attention to how you personally feel.

At @smarthealthfix, we break down nutrition, common health issues, organ function, and small daily habits so you can actually understand your body instead of guessing. Our mission is to make small, realistic changes feel doable instead of overwhelming.
